description: This file defines the ClientRepository class that implements OAuth client-related data access functionality, including client validation and retrieval, within a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Repository class responsible for managing OAuth client entities, including retrieval and validation, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Private method to retrieve an OAuthClient by its client identifier if it is enabled.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Returns a ClientEntityInterface object representing the OAuth client given its identifier.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates the provided client credentials and grant type against stored OAuth client data.

methods.name: validateClientSecret
methods.description: Private method to verify the provided client secret against the stored secret for a confidential OAuth client.
